text: For District 1 City Council Member, Moni Gangopadhyay's record shows a CAIR Action endorsement and a Vote for Peace supported rating of Ally, both in the general-election phase. Laura Babitt, endorsed by the Alameda County Jewish Democratic Club at recommendation rank 1, recorded statements opposing delegitimizing Israel and exclusion based on Zionism or Jewish identity while distinguishing criticism of Israeli government policy from antisemitism, and said she would be very cautious about international resolutions, prioritizing matters within Berkeley's municipal responsibility. Ross Bernet, endorsed by the same club at rank 2, recorded a position to keep the council focused on Berkeley and resist anti-Israel use of city government, stating he would have accepted the final Taplin ceasefire resolution while rejecting the earlier commission version.
